description: This file defines an abstract class GrepHelper with two inner classes (PcreGrepHelper and BsdGrepHelper) that provide implementations for constructing grep commands with different regex engines, and a static method to select the appropriate helper based on the environment.

classes.name: GrepHelper
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to build grep commands and retrieve regex meta-characters, with inner classes for specific grep implementations.

classes.name: GrepHelper.PcreGrepHelper
classes.description: Implements GrepHelper for PCRE-based grep commands, supporting PCRE regex patterns.

classes.name: GrepHelper.BsdGrepHelper
classes.description: Implements GrepHelper for BSD grep commands, supporting POSIX regex patterns.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of GrepHelper suitable for the current environment.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name used for grep (pcre2grep or egrep).

methods.name: getMetaCharacters
methods.description: Returns an array of regex meta-characters supported by the helper.

methods.name: buildCommand
methods.description: Builds a grep command string with specified pattern, context lines, and case sensitivity.
